notes: v493 — the 📊 history panel gets its opens, highs and lows from the server instead of fetching them per share. Two things were wrong: without your own data-provider key it showed dashes for every day (which is why the beta copy showed none at all), and even with a key the most recent days stayed blank, because the daily top-up saves closes and volumes only. The server now holds a full year of daily bars for every share, so it just hands them over — no key needed, and the newest days are the ones it is surest about. Needs worker w402. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
